ambiguities_or_notes: Both page markers, the bracketed notebook title, the dated opening, all notebook fragments, both deletion spans, five uncertain/illegible markers, the source's English words, and all four footnotes are represented. The exact source SHA-256 matched the mounted audited Russian snapshot.

«К Никто не виноват» is rendered 'For *Nobody Is to Blame*'. The phrase is a notebook pointer to Tolstoy's artistic project known under that working title; no later title is substituted into Tolstoy's note.
«о 1000-х повешенных» is rendered 'about the 1,000 people hanged', preserving the explicit numeral rather than generalizing it to 'thousands'.
«народную литературу» is 'literature for the people', preserving the intended popular/people-oriented sense without modernizing it to 'popular literature'.

The compressed fragment «Так хотел верить в самоотвержение для народа, что верит» remains deliberately compressed: 'So wanted to believe in self-sacrifice for the people that he believes.' No subject is supplied where Tolstoy supplied none.

The long faith paragraph preserves both deletions and Tolstoy's repeated constructions. «богопочитание» is consistently 'worship of God'; the source's awkward 'there can be neither faith, there can be no firm worship of God' is retained rather than smoothed away.

The difficult fragment «Казанская важнее Петрова дни. Сорока [illegible] копны.» is kept conservatively as 'Kazan is more important than Peter's days. Magpie [illegible: 1 word] haystack.' The surviving words are not expanded into an invented context or syntax.
The numerals in the 10 July note are preserved literally. *The One Commandment* is the established rendering of «Единая заповедь» in this unit and its cross-reference.

The English source phrase 'sayings of Ramakrishna' remains English in the body; its Russian footnote gloss is translated. Likewise 'Selfishness' and 'Apple' remain as Tolstoy wrote them, while their Russian glosses are translated in Notes.

«Советовал бы практическое как [unclear: соль]» is 'Would advise something practical like [unclear: salt]', preserving the editorial uncertainty marker rather than silently resolving it from a secondary witness.
The final surname/dream and passport fragments remain notebook-like. Reverse target-to-source audit found no substantive omission, unsupported addition, or loss of the source's fragmentary structure.
